## Install kluris 3.0.0-rc.1

### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/ngvoicu/kluris/releases/download/v3.0.0-rc.1/kluris-installer.sh | sh
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via powershell script

```sh
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://github.com/ngvoicu/kluris/releases/download/v3.0.0-rc.1/kluris-installer.ps1 | iex"
```

## Verifying GitHub Artifact Attestations

The artifacts in this release have attestations generated with GitHub Artifact Attestations. These can be verified by using the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_attestation_verify):
```sh
gh attestation verify <file-path of downloaded artifact> --repo ngvoicu/kluris
```

You can also download the attestation from [GitHub](https://github.com/ngvoicu/kluris/attestations) and verify against that directly:
```sh
gh attestation verify <file-path of downloaded artifact> --bundle <file-path of downloaded attestation> --repo ngvoicu/kluris
```
